_comment: Token optimization & pricing tier matrix. Tiers are abstract; bind them to concrete model IDs per deployment so the engine stays portable across providers.

economy.description: Mechanical edits, renames, doc tweaks, config bumps, formatting, log summarization.

standard.description: Code synthesis, refactors, test authoring, static security analysis, routine reviews.

reasoning.description: Architecture decomposition, cross-cutting design, ambiguous or novel problems, final CRITIQUE on high-risk merges.

frontier.description: Orchestrator brain and last-resort escalation after two failed attempts at the reasoning tier.

budget.on_soft_limit: summarize context, drop completed task payloads, continue
budget.on_hard_limit: halt dispatch, report partial results and remaining task graph to user
